in_sanskrit.name: Roshvika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Deity of Fortune, Goddess of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Roshvika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Rosh means 'deity of fortune' and Vika means 'goddess of wealth'. This name is derived from the Hindu goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth, prosperity, fortune, and the consort of Vishnu.
